text:
Devon Lee: Heads up — candidate for Senior Infra (CAND-421) asked to move from Wed 2pm to Thu morning. I tentatively moved the calendar and updated Greenhouse. Can we lock the new slots? Need confirmation from interviewers and who will lead debrief. Also quick rubric Q: are we on the new 1-4 scoring or still using 1-5? Uploaded sample prompts here: https://docs.internal/rubrics/CAND-421-samples
Jess R: I can do Thu 9–10am PT. Sounds good to me. We switched to 1-4 in the hiring doc last week (that's what I used for the last hire).
Mike H: Thu 9 works for me too. I can take debrief lead if folks don't object. Noted — rubric doc has a duplicated “systems design” header, I'll file a tiny fix.
Sara K: Pinged candidate via RecruiterBot, they said Thu morning is fine. Also sent a room-access request to facilities. Quick rubric note: in our guide 3 = meeting expectations (not neutral). I'll paste a short example in a sec.
RecruiterBot: calendar update: invite sent to interviewers. Candidate confirmed Thu 9:00am PT. Reminder set 24h before.
People Ops: Thanks — tagging @Mike H as debrief owner. Mike, can you create the debrief doc from the template and add a 15m buffer for handoff? Also we need to confirm format: live coding vs take-home + follow-up?
Mike H: I'll spin up the debrief doc and add a 15m buffer. My vote: take-home for depth + 20m follow-up live coding to probe tradeoffs.
Jess R: +1 on take-home + follow-up. Also prefer Google Meet link in exec_room_2 (less noise).
Devon Lee: Thanks — one more rubric clarification: Product asked if we should weigh 'judgment' 1.5x. Should we? If yes I'll note in Greenhouse.
Sara K: Product proposed that but the hiring committee agreed to keep equal weights for now. Let's keep judgment at 1x for consistency across roles.
Mike H: Agreed, keep 1x. I'll add a short note in the debrief doc about how to call out edge-case judgment examples.
Devon Lee: Perfect. If anyone needs to swap out, ping here with availability — otherwise I'll lock invites end of day. :thumbsup:
